name: Experiment planning card
audience: People preparing a bounded check of one business uncertainty
scope: A proposed experiment, with a decision rule and no recorded execution or results
unknowns: Whether suitable participants or source material are available
What the experiment will actually reveal
boundaries: This worksheet does not record execution, observations, validation or payments
Record actual results separately with provenance; retain later changes to the decision rule
User-supplied dates cannot prove a plan preceded execution

sections.prompt: Which single uncertainty should this experiment investigate?
What procedure will you use, and what comparison would be informative?
Which audience and situation does this planned check apply to? Do not invent participants.
What time, cost and resources are required? Leave unknown estimates blank.
What do you intend to observe, and how will you record actual observations with their source?
Before execution, which observations would support, weaken or change your next decision?
What limitations, exclusions and stop conditions apply?
